title: Jeremiah's Temple Sermon

questions.question: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord: "Stand in the gate of the Lord's... and proclaim there this word,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:2 (ESV): "Stand in the gate of the Lord's house, and proclaim there this word,"

questions.question: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Amend your ways and your deeds, and I will let you... in this place."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:3 (ESV): "Amend your ways and your deeds, and I will let you dwell in this place."

questions.question: "Do not trust in these deceptive words: 'This is the... of the Lord, the... of the Lord, the... of the Lord.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:4 (ESV): "Do not trust in these deceptive words: 'This is the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord.'"

questions.question: "For if you truly amend your ways and your deeds... if you do not oppress the sojourner, the fatherless, or the widow, or shed innocent... in this place"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:5-6 (ESV): "or shed innocent blood in this place,"

questions.question: "...and if you do not go after other gods to your own harm, then I will let you dwell in this place, in the land that I gave of old to your..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:7 (ESV): "then I will let you dwell in this place, in the land that I gave of old to your fathers forever."

questions.question: "Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, make offerings to..., and go after other gods that you have not known,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:9 (ESV): "make offerings to Baal, and go after other gods that you have not known,"

questions.question: "...and then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, 'We are delivered!'—only to go on doing all these...?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:10 (ESV): "and say, 'We are delivered!'—only to go on doing all these abominations?"

questions.question: "Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of... in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it, declares the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:11 (ESV): "Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes?"

questions.question: "Go now to my place that was in..., where I made my name dwell at first, and see what I did to it because of the evil of my people Israel."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:12 (ESV): "Go now to my place that was in Shiloh,"

questions.question: Because the people did all these things, what does the Lord say he will do to the house that is called by his name (the temple in Jerusalem)?
options: Do to it what he did to Shiloh
Tear it down stone by stone
questions.correctAnswer: Do to it what he did to Shiloh
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:14 (ESV): "therefore I will do to the house that is called by my name... what I did to Shiloh."

questions.question: "As for you, do not... for this people, or lift up a cry or prayer for them, and do not intercede with me, for I will not hear you." (addressed to Jeremiah)
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:16 (ESV): "As for you, do not pray for this people, or lift up a cry or prayer for them,"

questions.question: What were the children gathering, the fathers kindling, and the women kneading dough for?
options: To make cakes for the queen of heaven
To build an altar on a high place
questions.correctAnswer: To make cakes for the queen of heaven
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:18 (ESV): "to make cakes for the queen of heaven. And they pour out drink offerings to other gods,"

questions.question: "For in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, I did not speak to your fathers or command them concerning burnt offerings and sacrifices. But this command I gave them: '... my voice, and I will be your God'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:22-23 (ESV): "But this command I gave them: 'Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people.'"

questions.question: "But they did not obey or incline their ear, but walked in their own counsels and the stubbornness of their evil hearts, and went... and not forward."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:24 (ESV): "and went backward and not forward."

questions.question: "And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the..., which I did not command, nor did it come into my mind."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 7:31 (ESV): "to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire,"

key_verse_text: "Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it, declares the Lord."
